pelage_geometry_and_topology.patch_morphology: Irregular polygonal patches with non-uniform, moderately soft edge gradients. Spatial area varies from large, elongated shapes on the upper neck to smaller, more condensed geometries on the chest and shoulder transition.
pelage_geometry_and_topology.corridor_network: Continuous cream-colored lattice. Junction nodes are primarily tri-radiate and quadri-radiate. Pathway thickness is narrowest between neck patches and widens significantly toward the ventral and lower chest regions.

dorsal_ridge_profile.edge_serration: Low-amplitude, high-frequency serrated silhouette along the upper neck margin, consistent with short, upright hair filaments against the out-of-focus background.
